subject: mathematics
concept: Real-world multi-step word problems involving sequences, series, or rational function behavior, using the student's interest profile
source_inspiration: adapted from Singapore Model Method (bar modeling) principles — original content, not copied text

exercise.concrete: Student models a realistic scenario (loan payments, population patterns, repeated processes) using a sequence or series
exercise.pictorial: Student builds a table or graph representing the scenario before solving
exercise.abstract: Student solves a real-world sequence, series, or rational function word problem and explains their reasoning

misconception_flags: cannot identify whether the scenario calls for an arithmetic or geometric sequence/series model

interest_binding: word problems generated fresh from student's stated interest profile
